question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
solution:
The correct answer is '**derived**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage mentions that the name Hampi is related to the local mother goddess, Pampadevi.
 
• The word to fill in the blank should indicate the origin of the name Hampi from Pampadevi.
 
• "**Derived**" fits well as it means 'obtained from a source,' which aligns with the context of the name Hampi originating from Pampadevi.
